maddeler.e:
تخلخلت (form IIq)
# تَخَلْخَلْتُ (taḵalḵaltu) /ta.xal.xal.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَخَلْخَلَ (taḵalḵala)
# تَخَلْخَلْتَ (taḵalḵalta) /ta.xal.xal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَخَلْخَلَ (taḵalḵala)
# تَخَلْخَلْتِ (taḵalḵalti) /ta.xal.xal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَخَلْخَلَ (taḵalḵala)
# تَخَلْخَلَتْ (taḵalḵalat) /ta.xal.xa.lat/: t
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
